en: Colored illustrated postcard showing an ornate Ottoman-style public fountain on a street in the Arab quarter of Cairo. The fountain façade has intricate arches, metal grilles and rich decoration, with people in traditional clothing walking and conversing nearby. A narrow street recedes into the distance with a minaret visible, and there is a tree and a street lamp in the foreground. French captions and a German publisher credit appear in the margins.
